fix(links): a still row drawn while the counter was faulted gets its ranges back; the count is written through the one atomic write, flushed before its rename (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.b2l.e1n)

A frame is unchanged only when every lane encodes it as it did the last,
since the tmux status line's encoding reads ids the answers do not carry.
writeAtomic fsyncs before renaming, so a crash leaves the old file or the
new one, never an empty one. The reused stat names what it counts, and the
inventory docs stop naming the digest and the per-subscriber encode.

feat(links): a tmux range id is ccb plus a base36 link id from a counter in the home's state, held per session and surface and minted once a frame; the URL digest goes (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.b2l.e1n)

- A feed encodes each lane once a frame through one encoder per (session,
  lane), so the tmux row and `frames --lane tmuxStatus` share one minting.
- The tmux lane's encoder holds an LRU table keyed by the link's URL (cap 256):
  a redraw reuses its id, so an animating row mints nothing.
- The home's counter reserves ids a block at a time (hi/lo), so a restarted
  renderer starts past every id the last one issued.
- A counter fault is every bar's warning; its retry is the allocator's own
  timer, one attempt a still period, so it clears with nothing minting.
- Stats gain linkIds { minted, reused, evicted, reservations, faults }.

fix(facts): a recording replays a session's picks and open menus: each draw carries the state it read (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.gs4) (#639)

* fix(facts): a recording replays a session's picks and open menus: each draw carries the state it read (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.gs4)

A recording carried the session's documents and requests but not what its
clicks left, so a replay drew every pick absent, every menu closed, both
histories empty and no closing flash.

Each draw line now carries the session's draw state: the store's values and
revision for the session, the settings history's and back history's depths,
and when its menus' idle period began. The revision crosses as itself because
frame memory keeps the last frame only while it holds; the idle instant is the
one the draw was handed, which the daemon's draw and the seam rig both read
through one MenuIdle method that hands, draws and observes. The replay
restores each draw's state before drawing it. The recording format is v3.

* fix(facts): a recorded draw state the store could not have held is refused; a replayed draw whose depths held moves nothing (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.gs4)

* fix(facts): a session the store's file holds empty is not taken up, so a recorded state holds the store's revision rule; the replay restores under its view's session (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.gs4)

* fix(facts): the replay's depths compare every history field; the design states what a draw line carries (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.gs4)

## [1.201.0](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/compare/v1.200.1...v1.201.0) (2026-11-06)

### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

* **links:** one link grammar: a link that names no renderer is refused naming its form (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.b2l.eul) (#638)

### Features

* **links:** one link grammar: a link that names no renderer is refused naming its form (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.b2l.eul) ([#638](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/issues/638)) ([5b7989a](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/commit/5b7989a64a1f6bc3a423a4869e89dbf55505a6f4))
fix(disk): the fake walks a new entry's parent, makes a `..` folder, refuses a move into itself and forgets a failed watch; path derivation takes a Filesystem (candybar-testing-ihvy.y10)
fix(disk): the fake moves, removes, writes through links and resolves `..` as the kernel does; repo-configs is made on the tree that watches it; the real disk is owned (candybar-testing-ihvy.y10)

feat(disk): files and their watch events go through one filesystem port, first used by the watcher registry and the binary watch (candybar-testing-ihvy.y10)

A Filesystem port (src/disk/) with one adapter over fs, an in-memory fake whose writes emit the events a watch would on the clock, and one contract both pass. The watcher registry, its delivery owner, plugin storage, folder identity, the link walk and the binary watch read the disk through it; IdentityRead and BundleStat are gone. A lint rule bans fs outside the adapter, with an allowlist of the files still to move.
refactor(apply): a synchronous click needs no in-flight bracket on the idle clock; journaled refuses an async handler (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.1dh.c3l)
fix(apply): a probe link is refused by no client's leaving; the doctor stamps the hints it reads; the click error keeps its record's shape (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.1dh.c3l)
fix(apply): each click failure is its own held message; a fault's stack reaches the log; no gather starts after close (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.1dh.c3l)

feat(apply): no turn awaits a launch; a doctor step is an effect, and a held click error accumulates (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.1dh.c3l)

A turn is a synchronous call: its body cannot be async (Synchronous<T>), a
render request never waits behind another session's probes, and no draw can
read a click half landed. A doctor step describes an effect; the performer
gathers after the click's turn through a recording view, and the landing
checks the gather's read set and config in the turn that writes the report.
Lands yth: a click error held while the last is live joins it.
